paraphrase: A nonreference string lacking a terminal newline gains location text; an explicit nonempty newline-terminated operand is distinct from implicit propagation. Failed eval returns undef and stores the exception in $@. A __DIE__ hook can replace the error even inside eval.
quote: If the string exception does not end in a newline
